rounds.text: Eco Hotels and Resorts Ltd presents severe fundamental distress masked entirely by transient top-line acceleration, evidenced by an abysmal return on equity of -32.74% against a sector benchmark of 6.94% [E8] and an equally destructive return on assets of -13.71% [E7]. This wealth destruction is deeply structural, as demonstrated by a stagnant 10-year compounded sales growth rate of -2% [E13] and an operational profile that yields a negative price-to-earnings ratio of -6.63x while paying a non-existent dividend yield of 0.00% [E3, E5]. Furthermore, speculative enthusiasm has completely detached from underlying realities, resulting in a price-led dynamic where recent price growth exceeds profit growth by 204% alongside official warnings that earnings growth is actively decelerating [E47, E60]. Conceded: compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months reached 3364% and 5-year sales growth stands at 37% [E14, E15]. Despite these recent revenue bursts, the company trades dangerously at a price-to-book ratio of 1.96x relative to data provider benchmarks [E6], forcing investors to overpay for a chronically unprofitable enterprise [E7, E8].
